round.description: Rounded tip following a semi-elliptical arc. Soft and natural-looking, follows the curve of the fingertip.

almond.description: Tapered sides narrowing to a soft, rounded point shaped like an almond. Elegant and elongating. Worn long.

square.description: Straight parallel sides with a flat, perpendicular tip at full nail width. Clean and modern.

stiletto.description: Long dramatic linear taper to a sharp point. Bold and fashion-forward. Always worn long.

ballerina.description: Tapered sides with a flat, wide tip resembling a ballerina slipper (also called coffin). Trendy and worn long.
